tagline: A dramatic rocky headland with panoramic views of the Sea of Marmara and the Princes' Islands — one of Istanbul's most scenic but undervisited viewpoints.

items.name: Dragos Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A tea garden perched on the rocky Dragos headland with extraordinary 180-degree views of the Sea of Marmara and the Princes' Islands.
items.tip: Sunset here is one of Istanbul's best views. The islands turn orange in the evening light. Arrive 30 minutes before to get a spot.

items.name: Dragos Burnu (Headland) View
items.description: The rocky promontory at the very end of Dragos gives a spectacular panorama of the Marmara Sea, all five Princes' Islands, and the Asian shore stretching in both directions.
items.tip: Best on clear winter days when visibility can extend to the Marmara islands and beyond. Summer haze reduces the view.

tips: Dragos is best reached by taxi from Kartal metro. No direct public transport to the headland.
Primarily worth visiting for the view — there's not much else in the immediate area.
Combine with Kartal waterfront (a short drive away) for a fuller visit to this part of the city.
Clear autumn and winter days give the best visibility — go early morning for clean air.
